name: bottom-sheet
title: Bottom Sheet
description: Draggable bottom sheet with snap points, a grabber pill that stretches as you drag, rubber-banding past its limits and release-velocity snapping with a haptic tick on each detent. The scrim dims in step with its height, content scrolls once fully expanded, a footer stays pinned at every detent, and the keyboard lifts it. Large radius, hairline edge and a soft layered top shadow.
props: Called after it is dragged, flung, tapped or back-buttoned closed.
Resting heights, in points or % of the screen. Omit to size the sheet to its content (taller content scrolls).
Controlled snap index — change it while open to move the sheet.
Fires when it settles on another snap.
Allow drag-down / scrim / back to close; otherwise it rubber-bands at the lowest snap.
Left-aligned heading and muted line under the grabber.
Trailing node in the title row, e.g. a Reset link.
Round ✕ in the header (shown when dismissible, there's a title and no headerRight).
Body is a ScrollView: below the top snap a drag resizes the sheet, at the top snap it scrolls, and pulling down from the top collapses it.
Let vertical drags on the body move the sheet. Leave false if children contain their own ScrollView.
Pinned to the bottom of the visible sheet at every snap point.
Lift the sheet above the keyboard (capped below the status bar; the rest becomes scroll padding).
Light impact on open, selection tick on each snap.
Scrim dim at the top snap, 0–1.
Extra padding above the home indicator; pass useSafeAreaInsets().bottom for the device.
